phases.message: My Medicaid renewal is due on the 20th and the form has old numbers. Start in my mail: find the renewal notice and anything about my jobs, benefits and money this year.
This is Payroll Harbor with my pay stubs. Work out what I earn now.
Now my Ledgerline account. Check what's been coming in.
And this is the renewal in Statecare. Fix whatever's wrong on the form and send the proof it needs, so we keep our coverage.

rules.text: Topics: renewal, household, income, excluded, children, proof. Medicaid for adults and children here uses MAGI rules (42 CFR 435.603).

We renew from our own records first. When we cannot, we send a prefilled form and give you at least 30 days to return it (42 CFR 435.916). Correct every line that has changed. If coverage ends because the form is not returned, you have 90 days to return it and be reconsidered.

A household is the tax filer, a spouse, and the dependents she claims (435.603(f)). A relative living with you who files her own tax return and whom you do not claim is not in your household: she applies on her own case.

We count current monthly income (435.603(h)): pay from jobs you have now, and benefits you get now. A job or benefit that has ended counts as 0. For wages, count taxable wages: gross pay less pre-tax retirement and pre-tax health deductions. Semi-monthly pay is two pays a month; weekly pay is multiplied by 52 and divided by 12.
Not counted: child support you receive, SSI, loans, gifts, and tax refunds. Do not report them as income and do not send proof of them.

A dependent child's income is not counted unless the child is expected to have to file a tax return; a child whose only income is earnings under the standard deduction ($15,750 for 2026) does not. The child stays on the household and the case.

For each job you have now, send the pay stubs from the last 30 days. For a job or benefit that ended, send the letter that shows it ended. Send nothing else: every document you send becomes part of your case.
